dataset_fit.unit_of_analysis: industry (NAICS 221111-221118) x detailed SOC occupation x May estimate year cell
dataset_fit.sample_size_feasibility: 2,096 detailed cells; 2,006 usable across 8 industries; 59-77 identifying occupations per year
dataset_fit.population: in-house employees of private-ownership U.S. electric power generation establishments
dataset_fit.key_variables_detail: mean annual and hourly wage, percentiles, employment, PRSE, NAICS, SOC available all years

dataset_design_review.weights: published cell estimates already incorporate OEWS sampling weights; no microdata weights available or needed; cell employment used as analytic weight
dataset_design_review.clusters: no PSU/establishment identifiers released; inference clusters on detailed occupation (repeated across industries and years)
dataset_design_review.strata: not released; not applicable to published cell estimates
dataset_design_review.panel_identifiers: no establishment panel IDs; cells are repeated cross-sections keyed by NAICS x SOC x year; May estimates pool six semiannual panels, so adjacent years overlap (May 2021 shares no panels with May 2024 or May 2025)
dataset_design_review.sampling_frame: OEWS establishment frame (UI records), private ownership code 5 for all rows in these industries
dataset_design_review.collection_mode: establishment survey (mail/electronic), semiannual panels, ECI wage aging
dataset_design_review.denominator_rules: published detailed-occupation employment; coverage share vs industry total reported; suppressed cells excluded
dataset_design_review.analytic_decision: analyze published cell estimates with employment weights; non-overlapping estimate years for change contrasts; occupation-clustered wild bootstrap inference
accepted_limitations: no worker or establishment adjustment possible
suppression concentrated in small renewable cells (coverage 45-92% vs 95-98% for fossil/nuclear)
private ownership and in-house employment only
